Hymn 282: We Meet Again in Sabbath School
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Evan Stephens
Lyricist/Text Author: George D. Pyper
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 282 titled "We Meet Again in Sabbath School" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Evan Stephens and the lyrics were written by George D. Pyper.
